text:
Alex: Heads up — someone committed a semver string inside a YAML mapping and the linter gave up. :see_no_evil:
Maya: guilty. thought `1.0.0-alpha+build.2026` would be a clever way to mark a test config
Owen: YAML parser: "Expected <block end>, but found ..." classic
Priya: is this a yak-shaving opportunity or a real bug? :yak:
Maya: tiny yak, big feelings. Also the indentation was off by one space so the parser reinterpreted it as a list
Alex: paste pls
Maya: ```
service:
  name: 'widget'
  version: 1.0.0-alpha+build.2026
  tags:
   - beta
```
Owen: aha — `version` should be a string with quotes, otherwise YAML treats `1.0.0-alpha+build.2026` as a weird token and parsers go on strike
Priya: so semver fails, compiler laughs, CI fails, we have a patch party
CI-bot: build #4122 failed — YAML lint error at line 4: syntax error
Alex: Suggestion: add CI rule to require `version` to be quoted or run `yamllint` on commits
Maya: will open a tiny PR. Title: "quote semver or the yak eats your build" :sweat_smile:
Owen: +1. Maybe add a bot to auto-fix quotes? :robot_face:
Priya: i volunteer to write the regex that will haunt our future
Alex: please keep the regex small and benevolent
Maya: thanks folks :heart: Also pizza for the patch party? :pizza:
Owen: if pizza, I'm there — will bring stickers about semver
Priya: stickers: 'I survived semver in YAML'
CI-bot: Reminder: Next deploy window 18:00 UTC — avoid surprise semver parties then
Alex: noted
